draft.status: Draft from a Mac that is not the reference Mac; not record.json, and no decision. The acceptance tests count every budget here as INCONCLUSIVE, which would force a native verdict this evidence does not support.
gaps: Budgets must be rerun on the reference Mac (Mac15,7, M3 Pro, 36 GB, mains, thermal nominal).
preflightMs exceeds 5 minutes on every run because the perf step rebuilds the Rust tree cold in temp copies: windoliver/deepbuild#594. Checks alone took 24-26 s.

Panel inputs include docs/spikes/337/panel-brief.md, which is new in this change, and gpui-kit's docs, which are outside this repo; the acceptance tests accept only issue#337 and docs/ paths at the merge base.
The menu-bar screen captures the window's count; the NSStatusItem itself cannot be captured offscreen, so its PNG matches window.png.
Perf also flags repo-rules p50 (+50%) on both the branch and the merge base worktree; the base-side reading looks environmental.

deviation.reason: gpui-shell at M0 has no out-of-process panel host, and its release builds tier hot functions up to native code with no switch (shell_jit_config); debug builds, so the headless tests, stay on the interpreter. The spike loads the panel in the app through gpui-shell, as its Scope says. The heap, stack, microtask and pending limits and the 4 ms budget are the Fields' values, not enforced by this spike.
